contracts_revalidated: First rest construction allocates positions_binding_bytes (positive16 minimum) and copies exactly positions_bytes, skipping copy for0. Nonempty copied byte extent is a multiple of vec4 stride16, fits the already admitted output and the new rest allocation, and preserves resident bytes/order without copying allocation suffix.

Only native bindings0(rest)/1(output) are bounded to the canonical resident binding extent. Their positive minimum handles truezero without authorizing an empty SDK storage binding. Remaining simulation inputs deliberately retain whole-buffer binding pending their own checked source owner.

Replacing dynamics borrows prior rest handles instead of taking old state. wgpu::Buffer::clone shares the actual native handle; it does not allocate or recapture currently deformed data. Private self.levels changes occur only in successful set_groom/set_gpu_groom publication, each resetting dynamics before levels replacement, so retained same-index rest belongs to the same immutable resident level.

All new per-level candidates and rest-copy commands are prepared while old Dynamics remains present; assignment occurs only after queue.submit returns normally. clear_dynamics likewise borrows current state, restores exactly each logical resident prefix, skips zero copies and removes old state only after normal submission.
